sections.title: Day 46 學習概覽
sections.markdown:
- 掌握跨部門協作、資料隱私、上市流程相關詞彙 30 個
- 熟悉否定副詞倒裝、就近一致、分詞被動、截止時間及間接引述
- Listening 判斷有條件發布、時間依賴與更新公告的例外
- Reading 整合三份文件的預算、改期費及核准狀態
- Part 6 判斷資料保留例外與句子插入邏輯

建議訓練時間：**115 分鐘**。

sections.title: ② 今日文法｜Seldom / Rarely / Under no circumstances 倒裝、Not only ... but also 的主詞一致、Whatever / Whichever / Whether、完成被動分詞與邏輯主詞、By / Until / No later than
sections.markdown:
主題：**Seldom / Rarely / Under no circumstances 倒裝、Not only ... but also 的主詞一致、Whatever / Whichever / Whether、完成被動分詞與邏輯主詞、By / Until / No later than**

### 規則 1｜Seldom / Rarely / Under no circumstances 倒裝

否定或限制性副詞片語置句首，主句使用助動詞＋主詞＋原形動詞，或 be 動詞倒裝。

> Under no circumstances should confidential files be shared externally.

### 規則 2｜Not only ... but also 的主詞一致

Not only A but also B 作並列主詞時，動詞通常與較近的 B 一致。

> Not only the designers but also the project manager is attending.

### 規則 3｜Whatever / Whichever / Whether

Whatever 表不限定的任何事物；whichever 表在已知選項中任選；whether 表是否或兩者之間的選擇。

> Whichever option the team selects, Finance must approve the cost.

### 規則 4｜完成被動分詞與邏輯主詞

Having been + p.p. 表示在主句動作之前已被完成的事件，邏輯主詞必須一致。

> Having been approved by Legal, the notice was published.

### 規則 5｜By / Until / No later than

By 或 no later than 表截止前完成；until 表持續到某時間；區分狀態持續與一次性動作。

> Please submit the revised layout by 4 P.M., and keep the old page online until approval.

sections.title: 03 Listening｜Customer Testimonials and Conditional Publication
sections.markdown:
先閱讀題目，再聆聽內容並完成作答。

聽力稿：

> Man: The campaign page is ready. Can we publish the customer testimonials before lunch?
> Woman: I'd hold off for now. Two customers agreed to be interviewed, but they haven't approved the quotations we plan to display.
> Man: Could we post the page without those quotations?
> Woman: Yes, provided the privacy disclosure stays visible and the product specifications have been checked by Engineering.
> Man: Engineering signed off on the specifications yesterday. I'll remove the quotations and send you a preview link.
> Woman: Great. I'll check the disclosure and reply before noon.

sections.title: 04 Listening｜Shipment, Inspection, Photography and Website Release
sections.markdown:
先閱讀題目，再聆聽內容並完成作答。

聽力稿：

> Woman: Our demonstration tablets are due Wednesday at two thirty. Quality Control needs ninety minutes after delivery.
> Man: So inspection should finish at four, assuming the shipment arrives on time. The photo studio is booked from four thirty to five fifteen.
> Woman: Right. The designer needs another forty-five minutes to edit the pictures. Marketing can review them Thursday morning, but the final sign-off must arrive by ten for the eleven o'clock website release.
> Man: And if any tablet fails inspection?
> Woman: We can use the product diagram for Thursday's internal briefing, but the public website must wait for approved photographs.

sections.title: 05 Listening｜Updated Customer Analytics Webinar Announcement
sections.markdown:
先閱讀題目，再聆聽內容並完成作答。

聽力稿：

> Attention, registered participants. The customer analytics webinar originally scheduled for Friday, October thirtieth, at ten in the morning will now begin at two in the afternoon on the same day. Your existing registration link will continue to work, so please do not register again. The recording will be available in the learning portal on Monday, November second, at nine A.M. However, questions submitted through the live Q-and-A panel will only be answered during Friday's session. Clients who cannot attend live may email questions by Thursday at five P.M.; the speakers will address selected questions during the broadcast. Please note that the change does not affect next Tuesday's separate administrator workshop.

sections.title: ⑥ Reading｜Product Launch Schedule Dependencies and Budget Authorization
sections.markdown:
限時：**12 分 0 秒**。

### Linden Expo Center — Product Launch Services

> Linden Expo Center — Product Launch Services (issued October 20, 2026)
The exhibition booth rental is $620 for the October 30 launch. Demo tablets cost $110 each. Orders of at least eight tablets qualify for a 10 percent discount on the tablet subtotal only. Printed brochures cost $0.70 each. Standard transport is $55 per order. An audiovisual (AV) technician is available for a fixed $180 setup charge. A change to an agreed technician appointment incurs a $65 rescheduling fee. No other charges are discounted. All schedule changes require written approval from the venue and the purchasing department before becoming final.

用途：參考文件

### Orion Product Team — Purchase Request and Launch Plan

> Orion Product Team — Purchase Request and Launch Plan (October 23)
Event: Friday, October 30, doors open at 9:30 A.M.
Requested services: one exhibition booth; eight demo tablets; 200 printed brochures; standard transport; one AV technician appointment on Thursday, October 29, from 3:30 to 4:30 P.M.
Approved project spending limit: $1,850, including any rescheduling fees.
The purchasing department has accepted the original quotation. Marketing plans to test the interactive display immediately after the AV technician finishes setup. The team has not requested a change to the tablet quantity.

用途：參考文件

### Cross-Department Email Thread — October 27

> Email thread — Tuesday, October 27
09:10, Logistics to Operations: “The demo tablets are now expected at 4:30 P.M. on Thursday, October 29, rather than at noon. The AV technician needs the tablets on site to complete setup. The original 3:30–4:30 slot therefore cannot be relied on.”
10:05, Venue to Operations: “We can offer an alternative technician appointment on Friday, October 30, from 8:00 to 9:00 A.M. The $65 rescheduling fee applies. Early access from 8:00 A.M. has been confirmed. Please obtain written purchasing approval by Wednesday, October 28, at noon.”
11:20, Purchasing to Operations: “We are reviewing the additional fee because it may exceed the $1,850 project limit. Do not treat the new appointment as confirmed until we issue written approval.”
11:35, Operations to Marketing: “If Purchasing approves the fee, setup could finish at 9:00 A.M., leaving thirty minutes before doors open. We have not received that approval yet.”

用途：參考文件

sections.title: ⑦ Part 5 仿真題｜15 題
⑧ Part 6 篇章填空｜4 題
sections.markdown:
限時：**3 分 0 秒**。

### 閱讀文章

> Subject: Employee Training Survey — Data Handling Update
> 
> Thank you for completing the annual training survey. Beginning November 3, survey responses will be stored in a restricted reporting system. [1] _____
> 
> Before the results are distributed to department heads, all personal identifiers [2] _____. The summary will show group-level trends rather than individual comments.
> 
> Most survey data will be deleted ninety days after the final report is issued. [3] _____ Records that must be retained for a legally required audit will remain in a separate protected archive for the required period.
> 
> Employees may request a copy of the privacy notice from Human Resources. [4] _____ This will help us answer questions without exposing other employees' responses.

sections.title: ⑨ Day 46 小考
sections.markdown: 正式限時：**6 分 0 秒**。

sections.title: ⑩ 複習與錯題分類
sections.markdown:
回顧 **Day 43、Day 44、Day 45**。

### 複習重點
- **Day 43：更新期限與例外**：比較一般截止時間與例外適用對象，寫出誰能使用延長期限。
- **Day 44：時間依賴**：將「到貨→檢驗→拍攝→核准→發布」標成時間軸，計算緩衝時間。
- **Day 45：書面核准**：將 proposed、pending、approved 分成三類，勿將申請視為生效。
- **Day 46：隱私與授權**：分辨受訪同意、引言刊登同意、工程規格核准是不同條件。

### 錯題標籤
- `DETAIL`：明示細節
- `CONSENT`：授權與同意範圍
- `IMPLICATION`：言外之意
- `CONDITION`：條件性承諾
- `NEXT_ACTION`：下一步行動
- `TIMELINE`：時間軸計算
- `CALC`：數字計算
- `INFERENCE`：推論
- `DEADLINE`：截止期限
- `DEPENDENCY`：前置依賴
- `EXCEPTION`：例外條款
- `UPDATE`：更新資訊
- `TIME`：時間資訊
- `DISCOUNT`：折扣
- `BUDGET`：預算限制
- `INTEGRATION`：跨文件整合
- `APPROVAL`：書面核准狀態
- `INVERSION`：否定副詞倒裝
- `PRIVACY`：資料隱私
- `AGREEMENT`：主詞一致
- `PRONOUN`：代名詞選擇
- `WORD_FORM`：詞性
- `CONJUNCTION`：連接詞
- `PREPOSITION`：介系詞搭配
- `PARTICIPLE`：分詞構句
- `PASSIVE`：被動語態
- `COMPARISON`：比較級
- `INDIRECT_QUESTION`：間接問句
- `POLICY`：政策規定
- `RELATIVE_CLAUSE`：關係子句
- `REPORTED_SPEECH`：間接引述
- `TENSE`：時態
- `COHESION`：篇章銜接
- `REFERENCE`：指涉關係

sections.title: ⑪ 今日作業
sections.markdown:
- 複習 30 個單字並用 alignment、clearance、dependency、overrun 等任選 8 個造句。
- Listening 三組各聽兩遍：第一次隱藏 transcript，第二次對照稿件並標記條件性表達。
- 畫出週三到週五的到貨→品管→拍照→修圖→簽核→網站發布時間軸。
- Reading 限時 12 分鐘；獨立算出 $1,787、$63、$1,852 與超支 $2 的來源。
- Part 5 限時 4 分鐘、Part 6 限時 3 分鐘；逐題寫下正確文法或篇章線索。
- 正式小考 12 題首次限時 6 分鐘，提交首次答案、分數、耗時及 errorTags；複習後再進行第二次測驗。

questions.prompt: At what time should the inspection finish if delivery is on schedule?

options.C: It eliminates the need for quality inspection.

options.B: Questions can be submitted in the live panel on Monday.

quizzes.title: Product Launch Schedule Dependencies and Budget Authorization

questions.prompt: What is the discounted subtotal for the eight demo tablets?
What is the total cost of the original purchase request?
How much remains under the spending limit before any schedule change?
What would the total be if the alternative technician appointment were approved?
questions.explanation: 原費用 $1,787＋改期費 $65＝$1,852；原技師費 $180 已含在原價中，不應重複加。

questions.prompt: By how much would the revised total exceed the spending limit?
Why is the original Thursday AV appointment no longer dependable?

options.A: The venue is closed on Thursday.
options.C: The tablets are expected to arrive as the appointment ends.
options.D: Marketing withdrew the entire purchase request.

questions.explanation: 原技師時段 15:30–16:30，但平板預計 16:30 才到，技師需先拿到平板才能安裝。

questions.prompt: What is preventing the Friday appointment from becoming final?

options.A: The purchasing department has not issued written approval for the extra fee.
options.B: The venue has refused early access.
options.C: The event has been moved to Saturday.
options.D: The tablet quantity has fallen below eight.

questions.prompt: Assuming the revised appointment is approved and setup finishes on time, how long is the interval before doors open?
questions.explanation: 新技師時段至週五 09:00，開門 09:30，相隔 30 分鐘；題目已明確假設核准且準時完成。

questions.prompt: Under no circumstances _____ customer contact details outside the approved system.
questions.explanation: 否定介系詞片語 Under no circumstances 置句首，主句採 should + 主詞 + 原形動詞。

questions.prompt: Not only the designers but also the project manager _____ attending the briefing.
questions.explanation: not only...but also 連接主詞，動詞依靠近的 project manager（單數）使用 is。

questions.prompt: _____ of the two layouts the team chooses, it must display the privacy notice.
questions.explanation: 在兩個明確版型中選任一個，用 Whichever；後句說不論選哪個都要顯示隱私公告。

questions.prompt: The supplier has agreed to replace the parts at no _____ cost.
questions.explanation: cost 前需要形容詞 additional；at no additional cost 為固定搭配。

questions.prompt: Please keep the temporary banner online _____ the revised page has been approved.
questions.explanation: 保持上線是持續狀態，直到新版獲核准為止，用 until。

questions.prompt: The analytics team is responsible _____ removing identifying information from survey responses.
questions.explanation: 固定搭配 be responsible for + V-ing。

questions.prompt: _____ by the compliance department, the disclosure was added to the public website.
questions.explanation: disclosure 是被核准，且核准先於上線，使用 Having been approved。

questions.prompt: The revised brochure contains fewer technical errors _____ the previous edition.
questions.explanation: fewer 為比較級，搭配 than。

questions.prompt: The team cannot finalize the release date _____ the vendor confirms delivery in writing.
questions.explanation: unless = if not；沒有書面交期確認就不能定案。

questions.prompt: The report explains _____ the initial forecast differed from the final sales figures.
questions.explanation: explain why + 完整子句，說明為何預測與實績不同。

questions.prompt: All contractors must work in accordance _____ the venue’s safety policy.
questions.explanation: 固定搭配 in accordance with。

questions.prompt: The launch team will select the proposal _____ best satisfies the accessibility requirements.
questions.explanation: proposal 為事物，關係子句缺主詞，that 最合適。

questions.prompt: The final artwork should be submitted _____ 3 P.M. so the printer can begin on time.
questions.explanation: 一次性動作 submit 需在截止時間前完成，用 by。

questions.prompt: The manager asked whether the replacement units _____ ready for inspection the following morning.
questions.explanation: asked 是過去時，the following morning 表相對過去的未來，常用 would be。

questions.prompt: The survey results will be shared only after all personal identifiers have been _____.
questions.explanation: 現在完成被動 have been + p.p.，用 removed。

questions.prompt: Which sentence best completes blank [1]?

options.A: This change limits access to staff who are authorized to prepare the report.
options.B: The company will cancel all future training sessions.
options.C: Most employees prefer a longer lunch break.
options.D: The survey questions were printed in color.

questions.explanation: 前句提及 restricted reporting system，接著說明存取僅限獲授權的報告製作人員，前後語意連貫。

questions.prompt: Which phrase best completes blank [2]?
questions.explanation: identifiers 是被移除，且動作將在發送前完成，使用 will be removed。

questions.prompt: Which sentence best completes blank [3]?

options.A: Every employee must complete the survey again.
options.B: The final report will include employees’ full names.
options.C: An exception applies to records that must be kept for legal audits.
options.D: No documents will ever be stored in an archive.

questions.explanation: 前句為一般 90 天刪除規則，後句為依法稽核資料的例外，插入例外提示句最恰當。

questions.prompt: Which sentence best completes blank [4]?

options.A: The venue’s parking area will close early.
options.B: All employees must publish their responses online.
options.C: The reporting system will be replaced by paper forms.
options.D: When contacting HR, please refer to the survey title rather than another employee’s name.

questions.explanation: 後句 This will help us answer questions without exposing others’ responses，故應先提出避免提及他人姓名的聯絡指引。

questions.prompt: Seldom _____ such a detailed privacy notice in a product preview.
questions.explanation: Seldom 置於句首，主句要助動詞倒裝 do we see。

questions.prompt: Not only the trainers but also the coordinator _____ responsible for the final attendance list.
questions.explanation: 就近一致，coordinator 單數，選 is。

questions.prompt: Please submit the consent form _____ Friday at noon.
questions.explanation: submit 是一次性動作，表示截止前交件用 by。

questions.prompt: The client asked whether the prototype _____ available the following week.
questions.explanation: 過去敘述 asked 搭配相對過去的未來 the following week，用 would be。

questions.prompt: Why has the updated price list not been sent?

options.A: The regional director has not reviewed the discount notes.

questions.explanation: Finance 已查核數字，但區域主管尚未檢查折扣說明，所以尚未寄出。

questions.prompt: What will the man do next?

options.C: Save the message as a draft.
options.D: Publish the list on the website.

questions.explanation: 女方要求先存為草稿，男方表示會照辦。

questions.prompt: When will the equipment orientation now start?
questions.explanation: 新時間是週三下午 1 點；1:30 是設備示範開始時間。

questions.prompt: Who may obtain a temporary badge at west reception?
questions.explanation: 公告指出臨時證僅提供外部承包商，員工應帶公司識別證。

How much of the workshop budget remains for the current order?

options.B: It was canceled by the vendor.
